tools.name: marching_cube_add
tools.description: Marching Cube Surface: Generates a mesh from a level-set equation using the Marching Cubes algorithm. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

eq.description:
Equation for phi(x, y, z) = IsoLevel.
Also available: constants c0, c1, c2 and helper functions: a, b, c, f, g, h
Supported math functions: sin, cos, tan, arcsin, arccos, arctan, arctan2, sinh, cosh, tanh, abs, sqrt, exp, log, log10, log1p, where

constants.description: Helper constants, used as c0, c1, c2 in functions.

a_eq.description: Equation for a=F(x,y,z). Also available: constants c0, c1, c2.

b_eq.description: Equation for b=F(x,y,z). Also available: constants c0, c1, c2. Functions: a

c_eq.description: Equation for c=F(x,y,z). Also available: constants c0, c1, c2. Functions: a, b

f_eq.description: Equation for f=F(x,y,z). Also available: Constants: c0, c1, c2. Functions: a, b, c

g_eq.description: Equation for g=F(x,y,z). Also available: Constants: c0, c1, c2. Functions: a, b, c, f

h_eq.description: Equation for h=F(x,y,z). Also available: Constants: c0, c1, c2. Functions: a, b, c, f, g
